# What does the 60/40 rule save me on futures and index options?

> Free Section 1256 60/40 tax calculator for futures and index option traders: enter Form 1099-B boxes 8, 9 and 10, see the aggregate, the 60% long-term and 40% short-term split, the blended rate and how much 60/40 saves against short-term. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
